candidates.summary: track() pushes every indexed listing's event into the 20-slot activity ring, services and packages included, while writeActivity serves app events only, so toolbox listings evict every app event and the home activity feed reads empty
candidates.failure_scenario: Register an app (feed-app), then list 20 services (Claim kind service + Register from the service realm). Each confirm calls track("listed"), which checks l.indexed() but not l.shownApp(), so the ring's 20 slots all hold service events; api/v1/home then writes "activity":[] although feed-app's listed event exists and is newer than every core-app event. The gnoweb pulse moment (latestMoment over res.Activity) goes blank too. activitySize's own comment budgets room only for hidden listings and kind changes, not for kinds the feed never serves

candidates.summary: trending() walks appTrend.slots in array order (epoch % 7) and shares one trendingScan budget across them, so trendingScan entries in a lower-indexed slot exhaust the scan before a far hotter app in a later slot is read: Trending omits the week's top app and depends on slot layout, not stars
candidates.failure_scenario: Hot app gets 5 ranked stars at epoch 1105 (slot 6). At epoch 1106 (slot 0) 200 apps get 2 ranked stars each. trending(h,10) visits slot 0 first; once best is full its cutoff is 2 and bound 2 < 2 is false, so all 200 entries are scanned, scanned hits trendingScan and the loop breaks before slot 6. The home Trending shelf, the Trending list page and Block("trending") show 2-star apps and drop the 5-star one, with nothing marking the result as truncated. Swapping the slots (hot in slot 0, fillers in slot 6) puts the hot app first: the order of the array, not the scores, decides. Reachable organically at 200 apps with 2+ ranked stars in a week, or by a filler set of free address-namespace apps
candidates.verify_by: gno test . -run TestTrendingSlotOrderHidesHotApp -v (expect hotslot-app first, observe absent) then, alone, -run TestTrendingSlotOrderControl (same data, slots swapped: PASS). Fix to check: merge the seven descending slot iterators by bound, or give each slot its own share of trendingScan
